implemented: Updated specs/spec.json and 設計書.md so Sprint 3 is Fare Estimate Integrity.
Added fare estimate ranges to each generated flight leg and to the combined total per-person result.
Added confidence labels and estimate-basis strings for recommended legs, including season, stop assumption, and distance.

Updated the results UI so the premium presentation shows the main estimate, the range, per-person range, confidence label, and estimate basis without pretending deterministic fares are live inventory.
Added npm run test:planner, a deterministic planner smoke test that validates range bounds, confidence labels, open-jaw gap notes, and Skyscanner handoff generation.
Added next.config.mjs settings that keep local production builds stable in restricted Codex environments by using worker threads and disabling the webpack build worker child-process path.
Updated build/README.md with the new validation commands and estimate-integrity behavior.
known_issues: Displayed fares are still deterministic reference estimates and are not live API-backed inventory.
The price range is a local uncertainty band, not a statistically validated market confidence interval.
Interactive viewport verification still requires Playwright or browser automation, which is not available in this session.
Live fare provider integration remains deferred until after the approved Sprint 5 Grand Tour Ledger redesign and is now planned for Sprint 6 after provider and API credentials are selected.
